question_text: Outline how primary and foreign keys help keep loan/member data consistent.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: A member primary key uniquely identifies each member. A loan’s foreign key must match a member key, preventing a loan from referring to a nonexistent member.
